data_dictionary.chain_id: Stable seed identifier (slug); not an official retailer ID. Preserve redirects if a banner name changes.
data_dictionary.chain_name: Consumer-facing banner, explicitly labeled family, or licensed common banner.
data_dictionary.rank: Provisional competition rank by numeric reported store_count; ties share rank. Not a synchronized national census.
data_dictionary.sort_order: Descending-count display order; name breaks ties.
data_dictionary.store_count: Reported numeric count or stated lower-bound base. Null is unknown, never zero.
data_dictionary.store_count_display: Display string retaining a > qualifier where source says more than.
data_dictionary.count_qualifier: reported / official report / directory / more_than / derived; needed to interpret rank.
data_dictionary.count_as_of: Date or month associated with count source. Null means source did not state a date.
data_dictionary.count_date_precision: day, month or not_stated. Do not convert unknown source dates to the research date.
data_dictionary.states_50: Distinct US states out of 50 as reported/reconciled, excluding DC and territories; read state_count_status.
data_dictionary.dc_present: Three-state flag: true, false or null (unknown). DC is not included in states_50.
data_dictionary.territory_presence: Territories explicitly included/reported. Blank is unverified, not proof of absence.
data_dictionary.count_geography: Scope of the reported count, especially Puerto Rico or corporate US segments.
data_dictionary.state_count_status: Reported 50-state result or a jurisdiction discrepancy requiring reconciliation.
data_dictionary.count_source_url: Plain source URL supporting the reported count.
data_dictionary.states_source_url: Plain source URL used for state coverage; may differ from count source/date.
data_dictionary.count_source_type: Retailer, filing, published tracker, news, or other source category.
data_dictionary.entity_type: Retail banner, combined banner family, or independent common banner. Avoid parent/member double counting.
data_dictionary.format: Grocery/supermarket, supercenter, club, or mixed format classification.
data_dictionary.parent_group: Parent/family label where supplied; blank when not established.
data_dictionary.parent_verified: Whether legal ownership was explicitly verified. False includes not reviewed; not a claim of independence.
data_dictionary.locator_url: Official locator/homepage or candidate URL; always interpret together with locator_status.
data_dictionary.locator_status: How far the location source was checked; candidate URLs are not runtime-ready verified endpoints.
data_dictionary.store_information_availability: Directory reviewed vs source identified vs unverified.
data_dictionary.store_page_pattern: Observed/inferred branch URL pattern; placeholders must be replaced with source-derived values.
data_dictionary.store_page_example: A specific observed branch page, where available.
data_dictionary.pattern_status: Observed example, inferred family pattern, or not checked. Do not synthesize IDs.
data_dictionary.store_information_api: Evidence status for supported programmatic store data.
data_dictionary.product_catalog_api: Evidence status for supported product lookup/search, not live stock.
data_dictionary.branch_inventory_api: Evidence status for branch-specific availability. Exact on-hand quantity is not assumed.
data_dictionary.price_api: Price access status; distinguish in-store, pickup, delivery, loyalty and online scopes.
data_dictionary.cart_api: Cart mutation/handoff status; user authorization and explicit user action are separate requirements.
data_dictionary.map_status: Floor map, aisle guide, consumer map, or not reviewed; each is a distinct capability.
data_dictionary.map_source_url: Official page where map/guide availability was observed. Does not confer rehosting rights.
data_dictionary.api_profile: Foreign key to API Profiles. Shared family profile still needs banner-specific entitlement tests.
data_dictionary.api_source_urls: Documentation/reference URLs supporting the access profile.
data_dictionary.api_access_notes: Limits and interpretation; consumer interfaces and seller inventory are not public retail stock APIs.
data_dictionary.api_verified_on: Review date for access research; not a successful authenticated test timestamp.
data_dictionary.atp_spider: All The Places scraper name where inspected; null is unknown.
data_dictionary.atp_status: Code review and output validation are separate; no fresh output verification was done here.
data_dictionary.api_cost: Published monetary tariff where verified, otherwise explicit unknown. Not a zero-cost assumption.
data_dictionary.priority: Proposed engineering priority, not a retailer fact: P0 major reach, P1/P2 follow-on.
data_dictionary.notes: Per-row count conflicts, scope caveats, future openings and disambiguation.
data_dictionary.review_status: Sourced count, scope/count conflict, historical refresh need, or unranked discovery candidate.
data_dictionary.count_confidence: Qualitative source/provenance category, not a calibrated probability.
data_dictionary.scope_warning: Flag for family, jurisdiction, format or unresolved scope issues.
data_dictionary.next_action: Proposed validation step before production ingestion.
data_dictionary.bulk_ingestion_test: not_performed: no national branch census was downloaded, deduplicated or counted.
data_dictionary.store_count_is_current_census: False for all rows. Counts originate from heterogeneous published snapshots.
data_dictionary.suggested_ingestion_strategy: Proposed local-first adapter route; not a claim an adapter has been implemented.
data_dictionary.license_and_reuse_status: Reminder to preserve attribution and review source/API/image rights before rehosting.
data_dictionary.previous_count_evidence: Previous count evidence; retain as source/seed metadata.
data_dictionary.locator_source: Locator source; retain as source/seed metadata.
data_dictionary.atp_source: Atp source; retain as source/seed metadata.

recommended_store_schema.invariant: Do not use address text as identity.

recommended_store_schema.meaning: Separate chain, banner and actual franchise/member operator
recommended_store_schema.invariant: A single parent can have many banners.

recommended_store_schema.meaning: Exact retailer branch ID, kept as text
recommended_store_schema.invariant: Leading zeroes can be significant.

recommended_store_schema.meaning: Source-specific IDs with crosswalk and provenance
recommended_store_schema.invariant: SNAP / ATP / OSM / retailer records can overlap.

recommended_store_schema.meaning: Branch display name, grocery format, open/closed/planned
recommended_store_schema.invariant: Exclude planned openings from active counts.
US states, DC and territories must be distinct.
Use distance and address together for deduplication.
Required for hours and price observation dates.

recommended_store_schema.meaning: Original and normalized hours, with effective dates
recommended_store_schema.invariant: Missing hours are unknown, not always open.

recommended_store_schema.meaning: Official branch contact and source URL
recommended_store_schema.invariant: Avoid storing URL query tokens or credentials.

recommended_store_schema.meaning: Pickup, delivery, pharmacy, fuel, bakery, accessibility
recommended_store_schema.invariant: Separate fuel/pharmacy sublocations from grocery count.
Do not infer WIC from SNAP.

recommended_store_schema.meaning: Retailer product identifiers separate from GTIN
recommended_store_schema.invariant: Do not pad arbitrary store codes into GTINs.
Never compare delivery prices as equivalent to shelf prices without a label.
A listing is not proof of stock.
An aisle name is not a physical map coordinate.

recommended_store_schema.meaning: Map or guide provenance, asset hash and reuse rights
recommended_store_schema.invariant: Consumer viewability does not guarantee export/rehosting rights.
Downloading an old dataset today does not refresh its facts.
CC0 dataset, ODbL data and proprietary APIs require different treatment.
Preserve stable IDs through rename, relocation, closure and reopening.
